description.zh: 需要获取统计信息的域名。
description.en: The domain name for which you want to obtain statistics.
The data granularity. Valid values: **day** and **month**.

description.zh: 解析的协议类型，可选值：http（默认）和https。
description.en: The protocol type for DNS resolution. Valid values: http (default) and https.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun httpdns get-resolve-statistics --domain-name www.aliyun.com --granularity month --time-span 2 --protocol-name https --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun httpdns GetResolveStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --TimeSpan 2 --ProtocolName https --DomainName 'www.aliyun.com' --Granularity month
